verdict.rationale: First-party IAM docs say Claude Pro or Max subscribers log in to Claude Code with their Claude.ai account, and that teams can use Claude for Teams or Enterprise plans, with Enterprise adding SSO. Together these show the product directly supports signing in with an existing subscription plan. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the subscription sign-in flow, and documentation of how plan usage limits apply within Claude Code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Claude Pro or Max subscription: log in with your Claude.ai account.
Individual users can log in with a claude.ai account, while teams can use Claude for Teams or Enterprise, the Claude Console, or a cloud provider
Claude for Enterprise: adds SSO, domain capture, role-based permissions, compliance API, and managed policy settings for organization-wide Claude Code configurations.
